# A named slot's content has to reach the generated output, which is what the
# checker alone cannot say: a component value in a prop position used to type
# check and then vanish. Each assertion here is a position in the rendered tree.
#
# `header` is populated and renders the supplied content; `cell` is a scoped
# slot inside a `for`, so it renders once per row with the loop's value bound to
# the populator's own name; the anonymous slot takes the ordinary children.

sngl generate --out out table.sngl
grep 'Rows' out/index.html
grep 'alpha' out/index.html
grep 'beta' out/index.html
grep 'ordinary child' out/index.html

# An unpopulated named slot renders the insertion's own block, while the
# anonymous slot beside it still takes the ordinary children. A name-blind
# substitution puts the children in both positions, so "untitled" disappearing
# is what this catches -- and without it a fallback is parsed, checked and
# silently dropped.
sngl generate --out fbout fallback.sngl
grep 'untitled' fbout/index.html
grep 'ordinary' fbout/index.html

-- table.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

struct Row {
    title string
}

component table(rows list<Row>, slot header, slot cell(Row)) list<component> {
    vbox {
        header {
            text(value="(untitled)")
        }
        for r = rows {
            cell(r)
        }
        slot
    }
}

component main {
    window #w(href="/index.html") {
        table(rows=[Row{title = "alpha"}, Row{title = "beta"}]) {
            slot header {
                text(value="Rows")
            }
            slot cell(row) {
                text(value=row.title)
            }
            text(value="ordinary child")
        }
    }
}

output { none { html } }
-- fallback.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component card(slot heading) list<component> {
    vbox {
        heading {
            text(value="untitled")
        }
        slot
    }
}

component main {
    window #w(href="/index.html") {
        card() {
            text(value="ordinary")
        }
    }
}

output { none { html } }
